chunks: Surely in the watches of the night the soul is most receptive and words more telling.

key_terms.أَشَدُّ وَطْئًا: Heavier in pressure/footfall; metaphorically meaning the mind is more focused, serious, and the recitation carries more weight.
key_terms.أَقْوَمُ قِيلًا: More upright/straight in speech; meaning the tongue is clearer, the recitation is more accurate, and the words are more impactful.
key_terms.نَاشِئَةَ: The rising or emerging part of the night; specifically referring to the time when one rises from sleep to pray.

ai.seo_question: Why is night prayer considered more effective in Islam?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, this verse is often cited to emphasize the spiritual potency of the night prayer (Salat al-Layl), where the soul is less distracted by worldly affairs, allowing for deeper contemplation (tadabbur) and more precise articulation of divine words. Scholars note that the 'heavier tread' refers to the weight of devotion and the 'straighter speech' to the clarity of heart, making it an ideal time for personal supplication and Quranic recitation.
